query:
SELECT 
  cp.id,
  cp.userId,
  cp.tenantId,
  cp.segment,
  cp.city,
  cp.neighborhoods,
  cp.status,
  cp.createdAt,
  u.email as userEmail,
  u.id as userId,
  t.id as tenantId,
  t.name as tenantName,
  m.role as userRole
FROM commercialPointRequests cp
LEFT JOIN users u ON cp.userId = u.id
LEFT JOIN tenants t ON cp.tenantId = t.id
LEFT JOIN memberships m ON u.id = m.userId AND t.id = m.tenantId
WHERE u.email = 'davicristianodeandrade4@gmail.com'
LIMIT 1;
